claim: A historic build/ABI hazard is reproduced with an EXACT detector (not a generic build failure).
measured_observation: GNU Make expands a rule prerequisite list while the makefile is READ. A prerequisite variable defined AFTER the consuming rule is SILENTLY DROPPED: shape A (`out: $(INPUTS)` before `INPUTS = ...`) builds successfully with EXIT=0 even though missing-file.o does not exist and the recipe is reached. Shape B (the variable defined BEFORE the rule) correctly fails with EXIT=2 ("No rule to make target missing-file.o"). This is the exact hazard the repository Makefile comments document for the nine parser subjects, and it is the mechanism by which a stale or missing production CPA subject could silently survive.
